title: Ayurveda
subtitle: Doshas, routines, and remedies from traditional Ayurvedic medicine
lede: A reference to {videos} sources on Ayurvedic medicine — doshas, daily routines, and remedies as their teachers describe them.
about_paragraphs: A reference built from {videos} sources on Ayurveda — doshas, daily and seasonal routines, and remedies — synthesised into {library_files} knowledge files and {glossary_terms} glossary terms.

Every claim traces to a specific point in a specific source — a page, a paragraph, or a video timestamp, depending on what kind of source made the claim. Nothing here is generated: there is no model in this app, and it makes no network requests. It works offline, permanently.
